resolvedQuestions.text: Is consolidation into fewer larger multi-phase parents feasible and beneficial for context optimization?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Yes — feasible (spec-kit supports arbitrary phase-parent depth); beneficial for dependency-spine groups (010-substrate-and-orchestration, 020-mode-migration-and-cutover), marginal for independent leaves; safe only with timeline-first disciplined migration.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which child folders cluster into which multi-phase parents (by theme/dependency, optimized names)?
What is the full migration plan (renames + ALL reference/JSON updates)?
resolvedQuestions.answer: 15-surface checklist: parent+child graph-metadata, spec.md phase maps, adjacency lines, description.json, phase-tree.json, validate.sh embedded manifest + recomputed sha256, recursive-child-manifest.vitest.ts, specs/descriptions.json, 98 cross-repo files (both specs/ and .opencode/specs/ spellings), memory re-ingest, handover/docs. Execution order defined.

resolvedQuestions.text: How should timeline.md be designed so chronological lineage survives renumbering?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Append-only table with stable chrono_id (T001...), folder_slug, band, created_at, git_first_add, last_save_at, status, worked_order. Generated from git first-add + graph-metadata before any rename; renames update only slug/band cells.
